title: Israel election: Netanyahu-led bloc holds lead with nearly 99% of votes counted
summary: With nearly 99% of votes counted, the pro-Netanyahu bloc is ahead of the anti-Netanyahu bloc, but neither grouping is expected to win a majority, with tough coalition talks ahead. Follow DW.
byline: Patrick Große, Mark Hallam, Felix Tamsut, Roshni Majumdar, Matt Ford

image.caption: A finally tally of votes is expected to be completed by October 30Image: Saeed Qaq/Anadolu/picture alliance

blocks.caption: A high-ranking Central Election Committee official, too, denied the allegations.Image: Ronen Zvulun/REUTERS

blocks.text: Israel's Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's Likud claims large-scale foreign involvement in the elections led by Qatar and Turkey, with Israel’s authorities so far refuting the claims.
Israeli police said there is no evidence to support Likud's claims, neither "investigative” nor "informative.”
A high-ranking Central Election Committee official, too, denied the allegations.
